themes.summary: Many users say Columns makes beautiful charts, stories and embeds easily from CSV and sheets.

hits.quote: was already able to generate a few nice data visuals
easy to share with audiences via links
I really like this product and what its able to do!!
It is an incredible tool and so easy and intuitive to use.
My first day using it and I am extremely pleased with this purchase
you can upload it and get amazing, beautiful results.
This does the job really well—with beautiful designs, and many adjustment possibilities..!
Very intuitive, very beautiful graphics.
To take in large datasets at one go turn it around and summarise is pretty good.
This program has allowed me to be able to analyze,storeytell and visualize a bunch of raw data
I was able to use Columns.ai to create a map after watching a couple of short videos
Easy for me get around the UI. works well.
It is excellent so far, and I really like the simplicity of it.
I use columns to embed charts and anylse data in Notion. It works very well.
Columns is a fantastic tool that visualises your data sets in a variety of ways and options.
Columns is an amazing tool not just because it is so simple and easy to create beautiful charts

themes.summary: Several buyers say founder Shawn and support reply quickly, helpfully, even on weekends.

hits.quote: Huge thanks to the founder, Shawn, for the great product concept and being very responsive.
I personally talked to Shawn a few times super nice founder and very patient
I needed to speak to the team and was helped quickly too.
I needed support and asked questions. And get answer really quick and helpful answers.
he reached out within minutes and gave me a helpful walkthrough.
I have been blown away with the customer support.
They were excellent - eager to help and understanding of my challenges getting started.

themes.summary: Several reviewers say mapping, joins and advanced manipulation are too limited for daily use.

hits.quote: Maps are not able to be more granular than county level - no cities or lat/long geocoordinates.
You can only have one dataset and actions are quite limited.
The software looks promising but currently is quite limited.

themes.summary: Some users note missing polish like color storytelling, zoomable maps, and selectable sheets.

hits.quote: Whilst the palette chosen by the AI was aesthetic it did not contrast to tell the story
the map is not zoomable to drill down and view more closely.
when I asked a question, the response I got was "We need to add that"

themes.summary: A few reviewers report data not being retained, dates not recognized, and sheet connection issues.

hits.quote: It's not retaining my data I need to upload each time
At least european dates (dd/mm/yyyy), so chart can't be built using these dates..

themes.summary: One buyer calls it a great low-cost alternative to BI and Tableau.

hits.quote: Its a great alternative for BI or Tableu for a super price!!
